usageNotes: Use this to list all TFA entries (TOTP, WebAuthn, YubiKey, recovery codes, U2F) registered for a specific user. Callers must either hold Access.Modify on /access/users or be the user themselves (self-lookup is permitted). Returns an empty array if the user has no TFA configured — not an error.

examples.summary: List all TFA entries for admin@pam

tips: The userid must match the PDM realm format: localname@realm (e.g. kevin@pve, service-account@pam). The pattern enforces no whitespace, colons, or control characters before the @.
A disabled TFA entry (enable: false) is still returned in the list — check the enable field to determine which entries are actively enforced.
Recovery-type entries are one-time-use codes; their presence in this list does not mean any codes remain unused.
API tokens (allowtoken: true) may call this endpoint, making it suitable for automated auditing scripts.
